card.name: Agir Karadagi
card.tagline: A slow, heavy dance-melody from Karadakh
card.profile: Agir Karadagi (Azerbaijani: Ağır Qaradağı, meaning "heavy Karadakhi") is an Azerbaijani dance song that originated in the historic region of Karadakh and is very popular in the Shaki and Zaqatala regions, performed slowly (Azerbaijani dances, Wikipedia). As with much Azerbaijani folk dance, it follows the genre's smooth-to-lively character and is accompanied by traditional instruments; the musical meter of Azerbaijani dances is typically 6/8 or 3/4.
card.insight: Agir Karadagi exemplifies the many Azerbaijani dances named for their place of origin (Karadakh) and tempo ("heavy"/slow), part of a folk repertoire whose antiquity is evidenced by the prehistoric rock carvings at Gobustan (Azernews).
